page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Top: the end of a running paragraph, then three chapter summaries (CAP. XXII., CAP. XXV., CAP. XXVI.), each with a heading and a summary paragraph. Below a printed rule: a heading ERRATA with three errata lines. A handwritten scribble at the foot is not transcribed. No margin notes.

main_text.p: infœlicißimo Nasbejensi cum cætera Regia su-pellectile, & mox odiose divulgatas.
main_text.head: CAP. XXII.
main_text.p: Dissimulato habitu. ] Nempe Ecclesia-stico, quo duobus vel tribus comitatus ad Scotorum Castra confugit.
main_text.head: CAP. XXV.
main_text.p: Beneficio Cleri sui. ] Alludit ad id quod in Anglia appellatur Beneficium Cleri, nempe Gratia quædam in nonnullis Capitalibus Iudi-ciis indulta, quâ convictus malefici, si partem aliquam Sacræ Paginæ ut Clericus, id est, Latine legerit, à Capitali Sententia liberatur.
main_text.head: CAP. XXVI.
main_text.p: Hac Mei raptione. ] Rex in Holmbeja Custoditus, dum ageretur in Domo Utraque de remittendo Exercitu, nocte quadam à Cohorte Armata interceptus est, & ad Exercitum per-ductus, unde Magnæ Mutationes insecutæ.
main_text.head: ERRATA.

page.notes: The handwritten scribble at the foot of the page is not printed text and was left out. Several words are set in italic with mixed roman words; the italic boundaries are approximate. "Pag, 28." is read with a comma as printed; the "s" long s is written as s throughout.
